test_solve_stackelberg: test the solve_stackelberg function to compute leader's optimal commitment strategy and value in a matrix game
test_create_matrix_game: test pyspiel.create_matrix_game to construct a two-player matrix game from payoff matrices
test_game_payoffs_array: test game_payoffs_array to extract payoff matrices for both players from a matrix game
test_nash_equilibrium: test nash.Game with support_enumeration to find all Nash equilibria of a matrix game
test_stackelberg_vs_nash: test that the Stackelberg leader payoff is no less than any Nash equilibrium payoff
